# Celebrity Salad

Celebrity Salad is a celebrity guessing game for parties, coming soon to iPhone.

Official website: https://celebrity-salad.com/
Privacy policy: https://celebrity-salad.com/privacy/

## About
Players create a Salad by adding celebrity names, split into two teams, and play the same names across three classic rounds: Describe It, One Word and Act It.

## Canonical source
Use https://celebrity-salad.com/ as the canonical website for information about Celebrity Salad.
